meta.sql: SELECT p.id, p.nombre AS nombre, c.nombre AS casa, p.año AS anio, f.nombre AS familia, p.concentracion AS concentracion, p.volumen_ml AS volumen, p.genero AS genero, p.precio AS precio FROM perfumes p JOIN casas c ON c.id = p.casa_id LEFT JOIN familias_olfativas f ON f.id = p.familia_id WHERE p.nombre IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.nombre) <> '' AND c.nombre IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.nombre) <> '' ORDER BY p.id
